X.NAME: RNNt100
X.TITLE: 100 #times (-log_{10}(1 - RNN score))
X._COMMENT: Axis starts at 20 (RNNScore = 0.369): the RNNScore ~ 0 spike below that has a pass/fail ratio ~4x lower than the rest of the axis and no low-order transfer function can absorb the step. SIGSTART = 200 is RNNScore = 0.99, the blind point; with blindedFitSubregions defaulting to [SIG,HIGH] this masks the whole pass region above 0.99. Edges must be integers to match the fine (700,0,700) input binning exactly.

OPTIONS._COMMENT_plotEvtsPerUnit: Left off: plot._format_1Dhist hardcodes the y-axis label to 'Events / N GeV', which is wrong on this axis (the unit is 0.01 in -log10(1 - RNN score), not GeV). Note the pT-axis configs spell this 'plotEvtsPerUnitVolt', a typo that helpers.parse_arg_dict silently accepts, so it has never done anything there either.
